description:
*“I used to wish you’d just disappear. But I never thought it would actually happen.”*

Yun-Jeong, who wants to live a brilliant life marked by excellent grades and clear goals. Her older sister Eun-Ah, who longed for a simple, unassuming life without ambition. And Cheol-Yun, the man who became deeply entangled in the lives of the two sisters. Ju-Hwan, who had been quietly by Yun-Jeong’s side for a long time. Fate binds the hearts of the four together, leaving behind wounds that can never be healed. 

A predetermined future, family expectations, and conflicting desires lead to an irreversible catastrophe. The secrets of these three people and the guilt they carry are passed down, casting a shadow over the next generation…

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
